## Design

### 2026-10-08 – Today I worked on the PCB Design by using KiCad and starting the design for my Starbie!

**2h**

Today I worked on the PCB Design by using KiCad and starting the design for my Starbie!

Here is what I accomplished this session:
Setup: Downloaded and extracted "Week 1 Care Package," then installed the custom symbols and footprint libraries into KiCad.

I then created a new project, opened the Schematic Editor, and mapped out the core hardware.

I added the XIAO-ESP32-C3 as the main controller.
Added the Push buttons for inputs, wiring the side to a net and the other side to GND.

I added generic pin headers for the display screen, the MPU6050 motion sensor, and the DHT11 sensor for the temperature and humidity.

I then wired using net labels and launched the footprint assignment tool and mapped every symbol to its corresponding physical footprint to prep for the PCB layout phase. Next log, I will work on the PCB layout.
